It zooms around our black hole at 15,500 miles per second  SpaceAPOD: 2026 August 21 - Time-Lapse of the Star S301 Orbiting the Black Hole in the Center of the Galaxy  NASA Science (.gov)Discovery of a star sensitive to the spin of Sagittarius A*&
